summary: The Backrooms is a persistent survival RPG across authored maze levels, player-specific rooms, and shared destinations such as the Bonus Room mall. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors, place simulations and scenes provide local environments, and shared systems own combat, NPCs, loot, building, avatar presentation, and material-aware player footsteps. Human and furry avatars share deterministic looks and fitted assets; the Glow Up Salon lets seated players preview their live body while editing appearance.
places: places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with authored shops and landmarks, simulated staff, shoppers, balcony loungers, arcade games, and the east-ground-floor Glow Up Salon with usable mirror chairs and Gina; mall floor is tagged polished terrazzo for footsteps.
places/main (3D) - authored Level 0/Lobby maze; sim generates furniture and loot, safe-room almond water, shifting walls, creature ecology, and route-guidance moments.
places/intake (3D) + places/tutorial0 (solo ephemeral 3D) - bedroom character-creation/waking space and authored tutorial route with staged encounter and HALOGEN.
places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams, and Locked; Level 2 uses Tripo props over its collider shell, Level 2.1 has Base Alef and generated rooms.

places/level3, places/gamma, places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office, and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards, office/home systems, Boiler Room rats, and fitted human residents.

places/level6, places/level7, places/level10, places/level11 (3D) - later authored/generated levels including city, farm, and venues; Level 11 has human residents and a Faceling commuter; Level 10 routes to Level 26.
places/level26 (3D) - SS Fun =) Adventure liner in green fog with authored ship, decks, wrecked venues, Partygoers, and Phoebe; lower decks reach y=-80 within worldBounds bottom=-110.
places/debug (3D) - x1z0 is the mannequin animation/body gallery and HUMAN/FURRY switch pad; places/spamton and other configured places are auxiliary/fight spaces or continuing Backrooms routes.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, player/camera setup, and ordered behavior composition.

places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place settings, authored placements, and local generated/ticked behavior; places/main/sim.js owns Level 0 generation and timers; root sim.js applies body-style changes.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - title/pause, character creation, arrival, tutorial routing, first-arrival cutscene driver, and BODIES toggle.
places/intake/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/intake-geo.js + scripts/lib/intro-cut.js - bedroom shell and waking sequence; tutorial scene and tut0 scripts own its route and beats.
scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - camera and third-person toggle, including the seated salon self-view; scripts/ui.js and specialized UI scripts present HUD and panels.
places/debug/cells/x1z0.scene + scripts/dbg-pose.js + scripts/dbg-bodypad.js - clip-gallery mannequins and in-world body-style switch.

art/human-base/build.py + art/human-head/{male,hats,headtypes,revamp}.py + art/human-cloth/* + art/human-face/expressions.py - offline human rig, dedicated/refined heads, fitted appearance parts, garments, and facial expression/talk keys.
art/rifle-clips/{build.py,kf2body.py,retarget3.py} + art/tripo-hair/fit.py + art/salon/build.py + art/scissors/build.py - offline rifle clips, fitted hairstyles, salon storefront, and stylist shears.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations/crossings; routing and hub handlers use it for last-level selection/names.
scripts/lib/loot.js + items.js + weapons.js/weapons.yml - common loot spawning, container rolls, remains, place pools, and weapon definitions/rarity reused by search and combat.
scripts/lib/build-piece.js + breakables.yml + furniture.yml - canonical build specs/models shared by B-mode and home reconstruction; CRT TV builds attach scripts/built-tv.js.

scripts/lib/screen.js - derived read-only panel classifier and wrist gates shared by player, stats, craft, rest, and menu input; scripts/lib/footsteps.js - surface classification and stride sounds used by scripts/player.js.
scripts/lib/maze.js and scripts/lib/level*.js + level data - grids, zones, layouts, and paths reused by place simulations, geometry, and navigation.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml + critter.yml + faces.yml + hair.yml + critter-models.yml + scripts/lib/critter-model.js - player/NPC wardrobe, species and deterministic looks, human/furry bodies, heads, fitted hair, face parts, and garments.

scripts/lib/body3.js + scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml - shared third-person stance and combat animation channels for player and M.E.G. agents; long guns use authored Commando KF rifle clips and matching held-gun transforms.

scripts/lib/l2kit.js + scripts/lib/l2props.js and data - Level 2 kit decoding and metre-fitted Tripo props reused by Level 2/2.1; scripts/lib/loose.js + loose.yml serve shared kick/grab/flight/breakable prop effects.
notableExports: scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate and Level 2 container/loot helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - rarityIdx, rarityCap and weapon registry.
scripts/lib/l2props.js - PROPS, fitBox, spawnProp, dressRoom, dressHall, containerModel, crateModel.
scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update, looseSpent; scripts/kick.js - onInput, kickEnd, update.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget, and fishing handlers; scripts/lib/footsteps.js - surfaceUnder, stepTick.
scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom.

scripts/critter.js - update, onInput and face/blink handlers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - humanBody, humanMorph, humanFace, headModel, faceMorph, bodyModel, critterSpec, restyle/restylePlace, hair/head/beard seating, furrySpec and appearance helpers.
scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, react3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
scripts/wardrobe-ui.js - wardrobe; scripts/salon-ui.js - salon; scripts/salon-stylist.js - onSpawn, update; scripts/critter-beard-geo.js - geometry; scripts/dbg-pose.js - onSpawn, update.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, money, appearance, combat/rewards, level access, saved place/position, and wakeAtSave restoration; reload timing is session state; scripts/lib/footsteps.js uses per-machine w.fs for transient stride/surface/landing tracking.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - per-player kick rolls/cooldowns, carried prop/body IDs, held-body grip, and throw/carry session fields; target body state.heldBy/down controls hold and release.
scripts/lib/loose.js - arms matched props with state.loose/mat/hp/maxHp and owns broke/act effects; per-player session.loose tracks kicked/thrown item flights until impact.
scripts/lib/knock.js - shared physics/timing recovery for down/kb and thrown/overboard records; enemy managers retain AI state and pause it while held or recovering.
scripts/lurkers.js - player.state.lurkHold while caught and lurker entity grab/frenzy/prey state; release clears the player's hold.
scripts/build.js - active B-mode selection/ghost/session and placed build pieces; homeKeep.built persists home builds reconstructed by home sim.
scripts/hub.js - mall offer/shop/food and room-hop flags plus player trainHid/stungUntil; session.ride/rideTrain holds transient transit scene and spawned train.

scripts/player.js owns persistent look/style; scripts/critter.js and scripts/lib/critter-model.js present avatars; scripts/interact.js and scripts/critter.js manage salonOpen/wardrobeOpen; salon camera interpolation is scripts/camera.js seated-salon state.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/kick/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/spamton-fight/horde/critter/main-menu/hub/view3.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.
scripts/routing.js accepts permitted requested rooms; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects the player's solo Backrooms room and bonus overflow IDs.
Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js; START enters intake for creation or bonus for completed characters; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done.

scripts/main-menu.js BODIES action or debug pad → world.state.bodyStyle (menu also persists player.state.bodyStyle); root sim.js/critter.js select human or furry avatar and restyle people in occupied places via critter-model.js.

scripts/lib/hub.js toHub/toSolo → room/place crossings and roomHop distinguishes intentional crossings from launch/resume; hub.js hubOffer → hub-ui.js for death recovery, while mall counters write hubShop for the hub handler/UI and purchases debit cents/grant configured stock.

Teleport Station UI in scripts/hub-ui.js renders lastLevel(s) from scripts/lib/hub.js; travel requests reach scripts/hub.js, which boards the player via bc-train, animates a session train, and crosses to the destination.
Found loot search → scripts/interact.js calls loot.gateItems for non-storage/non-NPC contents; rarity caps are level 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; pickups enter player.js inventory.
L input → scripts/kick.js tries foe kick then loose.js kickLoose; Z input → scripts/grab.js carries/throws eligible bodies and calls loose.js arm/track/impact; flight tracking detects hard stops.

Player and M.E.G. gun/combat handlers → scripts/lib/body3.js stance/swing/fire/aim/reload → scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml clip rows; long guns use Commando KF clips with upper-body masking over gait and calibrated heldRot hand-frame transforms.

Bonus salon seat (tag seat, state.salon) → scripts/interact.js sits player and opens salonOpen/wardrobeOpen; scripts/ui.js renders scripts/salon-ui.js, actions reach scripts/critter.js to edit look; scripts/camera.js detects seated salonOpen for self-view.

scripts/player.js calls scripts/lib/footsteps.js stepTick → detects drawn floor geometry first, then collider/terrain or floorOf fallback; surface and stride state select walk/run, crouch/weight, scuff and landing clips heard by nearby friends.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js + scripts/mall-shopper.js - authored mall shops/landmarks with data-driven stock and simulated staff, waypoint shoppers, balcony loungers, arcade games, and transit.

places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + art/salon/build.py + scripts/salon-stylist.js + scripts/salon-ui.js - Glow Up Salon shell and fitted furniture, three mirror-chair service spots, Gina's custom upper-body cut/hand-IK/voice/fx behavior, and salon editing flow.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + places/home11/sim.js - per-piece models/dimensions with common placement, persistence, and rebuild path; CRT TV builds attach screen, sound, and glow.

places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures with local sound/light and zone variants; Level 5 includes portal/quest props, Boiler Room Death Rat packs, and fitted human residents.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office layout and fixtures with resident schedules/home claims.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - per-NPC role/dialogue/look/routine on shared meg-agent behavior.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter.yml/faces.yml/hair.yml/critter-models.yml + art/human-cloth/* + art/tripo-hair/fit.py + art/human-head/revamp.py - deterministic human/furry looks; sex-specific human bodies/heads, skinned expression shapes, fitted garments, and hair.

scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml + scripts/lib/body3.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/critter.js + scripts/meg-agent.js - shared upper-body combat and human gait with NPC idles, head tracking/fidgets, expressions and dialogue.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - exports procedural balloon geometry/skeleton/collider but Level 26 scene placements and barrage use uploaded models instead.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - header marks it as a temporary hair lane test rig; no tree/package references found.
migrationNotes: Bonus Room uses shared room/place bonus; soloRoom(userId) names each player's Backrooms room and overflow mall rooms use bonus-N IDs. Teleport Station last travel derives from savePlace (excluding bonus, intake, debug; tutorial0 maps to main); keepPos preserves savePos and wakeAtSave restores only when arriving at the matching place; transit depends on bc-train assets.
Found-item rarity gates apply only to found weapon tokens; existing weapon ownership/use and non-weapon loot are not level-gated. Search gating excludes storage and NPC containers.

Level 0 place.state.momentsV is 4: migration deletes old tagged moment entities before relaying them; preserve deterministic route/arrow direction logic when changing moment layout. Wet-arch movement/footstep effects are scoped to main.

Footstep surface detection checks visible geometry within 0.45 m before the collider (so non-colliding rugs can supply the sound), then terrain/material and player.js floorOf fallback; retain material words/tags such as the Bonus floor's polished terrazzo state when editing surfaces.

Level 2 l2props.yml sizes are metres; fitBox places its mesh collider from floor y=0. Props spawn static to avoid falling through before floor mesh cooking; Level 2.1 revisioned rebuild must preserve generated placement identity.

Human body/head GLBs are shared skinned rigs: keep male/female asset IDs, body part/material and shape-key names (X_* facial expressions plus Beard_*/Blush_*), cloth-slot alignment, and hair.yml indices consistent with critter-model.js.
